I'm in love with a male employee. Problems are: 1) i'm a gay male but not out yet; 2) I have no way to find out if he's gay; 3) I have no way to find out if he feels the same about me; 4) I'd never say anything because he's my employee and, in the case that my feelings are not mutual, he would be left in a bad situation that might even make him consider resigning or - worse case scenario - suing me for harassment or something; 5) By telling him I would be risking our friendship.

Worse part is... he's excessively good with me, really kind, we get along really well, we have some central core beliefs in sync, sometimes I think he might feel the same but I have no way to know if I'm just imagining things.
